title: Unravelling the progression of the zebrafish primary body axis with reconstructed spatiotemporal transcriptomics.
authors: Dong, Yang; Cheng, Tao; Liu, Xiang; Fu, Xin-Xin; Hu, Yang; Yang, Xian-Fa; Yang, Ling-En; Li, Hao-Ran; Bian, Zhi-Wen; Jing, Naihe; Liao, Jie; Fan, Xiaohui; Xu, Peng-Fei
one_liner_zh: 该文用Palette流程重建斑马鱼时空转录组并筛选前后轴发育相关转录因子，但核心是转录组图谱与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Elucidating the spatiotemporal dynamics of gene expression is essential for understanding complex physiological and pathological processes. Current spatial transcriptomics techniques are hindered by low read depths and limited gene detection. RESULTS: Here, we introduce Palette, a pipeline that infers detailed spatial gene expression patterns from bulk RNA-seq data, utilizing existing spatial transcriptomics data as the sole reference. This method identifies more precise expression patterns by smoothing, imputing and adjusting gene expressions. We apply Palette to reconstruct the zebrafish SpatioTemporal Expression Profiles (zSTEP) by integrating 53-slice serial bulk RNA-seq data from three developmental stages with existing spatial transcriptomics and image references. zSTEP provides a comprehensive cartographic resource for examining gene expression and investigating developmental events within zebrafish embryos. Utilizing machine learning-based screening, we identify key morphogens and transcription factors essential for anteroposterior axis development and characterized their dynamic distribution throughout embryogenesis. In addition, among these transcription factors, Hox family genes are found to be pivotal in anteroposterior axis refinement. Their expression is closely correlated with cellular anteroposterior identities, and hoxb genes may act as central regulators in this process. CONCLUSIONS: This study presents Palette, a pipeline for integrating bulk RNA-seq data and spatial transcriptomics data, and zSTEP, a comprehensive cartographic resource for investigating zebrafish early embryonic development. In addition, key morphogens and transcriptional factors essential for anteroposterior axis establishment and refinement are identified.
abstract_zh: 背景：阐明基因表达的时空动态对于理解复杂的生理和病理过程至关重要。当前的空间转录组学技术受限于较低的测序深度和有限的基因检测能力。结果：在此，我们介绍了Palette，一种从批量RNA测序数据中推断详细空间基因表达模式的流程，仅利用现有的空间转录组学数据作为参考。该方法通过平滑、插补和调整基因表达，识别出更精确的表达模式。我们应用Palette，通过整合来自三个发育阶段的53切片系列批量RNA测序数据与现有空间转录组学和图像参考，重建了斑马鱼时空表达谱（zSTEP）。zSTEP提供了一个全面的图谱资源，用于检查斑马鱼胚胎中的基因表达和研究发育事件。利用基于机器学习的筛选，我们识别了前后轴发育所必需的关键形态发生素和转录因子，并表征了它们在整个胚胎发生过程中的动态分布。此外，在这些转录因子中，发现Hox家族基因在前-后轴细化中起关键作用。它们的表达与细胞前后轴身份密切相关，且hoxb基因可能在此过程中充当中心调节因子。结论：本研究介绍了Palette，一种用于整合批量RNA测序数据和空间转录组学数据的流程，以及zSTEP，一个用于研究斑马鱼早期胚胎发育的全面图谱资源。此外，还识别了前后轴建立和细化所必需的关键形态发生素和转录因子。
